message.content:
Los Angeles (Pacific Time) is **9 hours behind** Berlin (Central European Time).

| Season | Los Angeles UTC offset | Berlin UTC offset | Time difference |
|--------|------------------------|-------------------|-----------------|
| Standard (winter) | UTC‑8 (PST) | UTC+1 (CET) | +9 h |
| Daylight‑saving (summer) | UTC‑7 (PDT) | UTC+2 (CEST) | +9 h |

Because both regions shift forward and backward at roughly the same dates, the gap stays constant at 9 hours. If you’re looking at a specific date when one side has already switched to DST and the other hasn’t, the difference could temporarily be 8 or 10 hours, but for most practical purposes it’s 9 hours.
